label: Dawn
description: Masters of war in all its forms, the Children of the Dawn were once the leaders and champions of the Celestial Armies. The Unconquered Sun chooses the Dawn Caste from those with a talent for the arts of combat and war.
anima_powers: By spending 10 motes, the character appears huge and terrifying for the rest of the scene (or until she lets the effect dissipate). Mortals trying to face her must make a Valor check or suffer -2 dice on all attacks against her; those who botch the roll (and most natural animals) flee in terror. Golems, automata, demons, the undead and others that know no fear are immune.

label: Zenith
description: Once the leaders of the Solar Exalted, the Lightbringers are priest-kings, prophets and mystics. The Unconquered Sun chooses the Zenith Caste from those most fit for righteousness and justice, as well as from among the leaders of men.
anima_powers: With a touch, the character burns the body of a fallen creature for 1 mote per body, sending the smoke and soul to Heaven and preventing it from rising as a zombie or hungry ghost. As her action for a turn, she may channel 5 motes to strike a demon, undead or other creature of darkness within 10 yards, rolling her Essence as dice of unsoakable aggravated damage.

label: Twilight
description: Scholars and craftsmen of the Solar Exalted, the Children of Twilight are thinkers and doers. The Unconquered Sun chooses the Twilight Caste from those most able to take knowledge and apply it to create concrete results.
anima_powers: As a last-ditch protective act, after damage is rolled but before health levels are lost, the character may spend 5 motes and roll her Essence; each success subtracts one health level from the incoming damage, potentially turning a deadly blow harmless.

label: Night
description: Lords of stealth and trickery, the Concealing Shadows once served as the security of the Celestial Empire. The Unconquered Sun chooses the Night Caste from those who excel in entering places where they are not wanted or in finding unconventional solutions to problems.
anima_powers: The character may mute her anima: when spending peripheral Essence she pays twice as many motes to keep the expenditure from adding to her anima banner (this does not mute displays caused by sorcery). She may also spend 10 motes to extend the muting as a veil around her for a scene, increasing the difficulty of all rolls to detect or track her by 1.

label: Eclipse
description: Diplomats and bureaucrats, the Crowned Suns were the force that kept the Celestial Empire running smoothly. The Unconquered Sun chooses the Eclipse Caste from those who master the art of communication in all its forms.
anima_powers: By spending 10 motes and 1 Willpower and touching hands to seal an agreement, the character sanctifies an oath. Anyone who breaks it (including the Exalted) is cursed: a number of times equal to the Exalted's Essence at the time of the oath, the oathbreaker horribly botches a critical roll at the worst possible moment. Eclipses are also protected by ancient pacts, granting diplomatic immunity when dealing with spirits, demons and the Fair Folk.

label: Air
description: Creatures of thought and dreams, the Children of Mela are as subtle as a gentle breeze and as dynamic as a thunderstorm. Air Exalted excel at scholarship and subtle motion.
anima_powers: An Aspect of Air can spend 5 motes to attune his anima to the nearby winds, allowing them to bear him aloft. For the rest of the scene, he may triple his leaping distance and takes no damage from falls.

label: Earth
description: Embodiments of endurance and stability, the Children of Pasiap are the bedrock upon which the Realm sits — durable as a mountain and as unstoppable as an avalanche.
anima_powers: An Aspect of Earth can spend 5 motes to attune her anima to the nearby stone, taking on the durability of the earth itself. For the rest of the scene, she can soak lethal damage with her entire Stamina.

label: Fire
description: Passion and energy incarnate, the Children of Hesiesh are as brilliant as a bonfire and as dangerous as a wildfire, brimming with physical and emotional energy.
anima_powers: A Fire-aspected Dragon-Blooded can spend 5 motes to ignite her anima. For the rest of the scene she is immune to fire damage, and anyone striking her without a weapon or wrestling with her takes a number of dice of lethal damage every turn equal to the Chosen's Essence (applied separately from any damage she deals; armour applies to it).

label: Water
description: Mercurial and fluid-minded masters of adaptation, the Children of Daana'd are as deep as the ocean and as relentless as a flood, filling and exploiting any circumstance.
anima_powers: An Aspect of Water can spend 5 motes to attune his anima with the surrounding water. For the rest of the day he can breathe underwater and operate as freely as if he were in air, including firing bows and the like.

label: Wood
description: Attuned to the cycles of life and nature, the Children of Sextes Jylis are as solid as oaks, as beautiful as orchids and as deadly as hemlock.
anima_powers: A Wood-aspected Dragon-Blooded may spend 5 motes to attune her anima to the local flora, becoming as flexible as a sapling in the wind. For the rest of the scene she may add her Essence in dice to a single Dodge or Athletics action once per turn (reflexive, not supplemental — she may instead take a free Dodge or Athletics action with a dice pool equal to her Essence).

label: Dusk
description: Masters of bringing death through war, the Peacebringers are the leaders and champions of the Underworld's armies. The Deathlords choose the Dusk Caste from those with a talent for the arts of combat and weaponry.
anima_powers: By spending 10 motes of Essence, the deathknight appears dark and terrible for the rest of the scene (or until he lets the effect dissipate). Mortals attempting to face him must make a Valor check or be unable to look directly at him or strongly oppose him, taking -2 dice on all attempts to attack him. Those who botch the Valor roll — and most natural animals — flee in terror.

label: Midnight
description: The Echoes of the Abyss are high priests and evangelists of death. The Deathlords choose the Midnight Caste from those who crave the end of all life and wish to awaken that craving in others.
anima_powers: With a touch, the deathknight raises the fallen: she spends 5 motes of Essence and touches a corpse, which rises as a zombie (permanent duration, always an extra) by the end of the scene. She may also strike down the living with an icy glance — as her action she channels 5 motes of Essence through her anima and indicates a normal mortal within 10 yards, inflicting her Essence in dice of unsoakable aggravated damage. This glance has no effect on the Fair Folk, the Exalted or other magical beings.

label: Daybreak
description: Necromancers and craftsmen of the Abyssal Exalted, the Children of Bone are dark and morbid artisans. The Deathlords choose the Daybreak Caste from those who seek the darkest forms of knowledge and apply it to create horrifying results.
anima_powers: After an enemy has rolled damage that would cost the deathknight health levels, he may spend 5 motes of Essence to fill his anima with the power of the Underworld and blunt the blow. Roll his Essence: each success subtracts one health level from the damage — enough to reduce a weak attack to harmlessness or survive an otherwise-deadly strike.

label: Day
description: Lords of stealth and trickery, the Daywalkers walk unseen among the living. The Deathlords choose the Day Caste from those who excel in entering places where they are not wanted or in finding unconventional ways of bringing death.
anima_powers: The Day Caste can mute their animas. By doubling the motes spent, the deathknight prevents an expenditure of Peripheral Essence from adding to her anima banner (this cannot mute the Essence display of sorcery). She may also spend 5 motes of Essence to extend her muted anima like a choking cloak for the scene, dulling the senses of those who would perceive her or follow her trail — increasing the difficulty of all rolls to detect or track her by 1.

label: Moonshadow
description: Diplomats and bureaucrats, the Hollow Darkness is the force that keeps the empires of the dead running smoothly. The Deathlords chose the Moonshadow Caste from those who master the arts of negotiation, travel and treachery.
anima_powers: When party or witness to an oath, the deathknight may sanctify it: touching the hands of those sworn, he spends 10 motes of Essence and 1 Willpower. An oathbreaker suffers terrible luck, horribly botching a critical roll a number of times equal to the deathknight's Essence when he witnessed the oath. Moonshadows are also gifted generalists — with a willing tutor they may learn the Charms of other Exalted and even spirits (including ghosts), though such Charms cost double the experience to learn and use.

label: Full Moon
description: Engines of fury who survive via speed and strength. Full Moon Lunars are the Silver Pact's greatest warriors, unparalleled in physical prowess and terrifying in single combat.
anima_powers: A Full Moon Lunar can spend 5 motes to attune her anima to her body, honing her physical prowess. For the rest of the scene, she can double her running and leaping distances. As more Essence is spent, the light grows in strength and intensity.

label: Changing Moon
description: Cunning tricksters who survive via cunning and guile. Changing Moon Lunars are the Silver Pact's premier spies, assassins and leaders, masters of misdirection and illusion.
anima_powers: A Changing Moon Lunar may spend 10 motes to cloak himself in a veil of illusion for a scene, appearing to be someone else. This effect ends if the character's anima banner activates at any level or if he has significant physical interaction (such as combat or sex) with another intelligent creature; it does not change the character's scent or voice, and creatures of deception (the Fair Folk) are immune.

label: No Moon
description: Subtle mystics who survive via intelligence and sorcerous skill. No Moon Lunars are the Silver Pact's master sorcerers and the keepers of the Lunars' entire history and culture.
anima_powers: A No Moon Lunar may attune her anima to work sorcery, reducing the Essence needed to cast spells: for each mote she spends to attune her anima this way, the Essence cost of all spells cast for the rest of the scene is lowered by 1 (may not spend more than twice her Essence this way in a scene; a spell's cost cannot be reduced by more than half, rounded down). Spending Essence this way is reflexive and does not count as a Charm for the purposes of how many Charms the character can use in a turn, but it cannot be done while casting a spell.

label: Casteless
description: Lunar Exalted who, for one reason or another, are not adopted into the Society of the Moon. With no elders to supervise his rite of passage and mark him with the ritual scars and tattoos, a Casteless Lunar has no caste. As a result, a Casteless character does not possess any Caste Attributes, and must pay full cost for all Charms and Attribute increases; in addition, his lack of tutelage means he starts with fewer Attributes, fewer Charms, and no Ability minimums or Renown.
anima_powers: Varies: for three days a month a Casteless Lunar has the Full Moon anima power, for three days the No Moon power, and for the other twenty-two days the Changing Moon power.

label: Chosen of Journeys
description: Heaven's Messengers, the Chosen of Journeys serve the Maiden of Journeys and the Golden Barque of the Heavens. They travel anywhere in Creation they may be needed, carrying the mandates of destiny to the farthest reaches of the world.
anima_powers: By spending 10 motes, the character may triple her own and her allies' running speeds for the rest of the scene.

label: Chosen of Serenity
description: Heaven's Courtesans, the Chosen of Serenity serve the Maiden of Serenity and the Cerulean Lute of Harmony. They oversee gatherings of both gods and men, and the arts of civilization and pleasure.
anima_powers: By spending 10 motes, the character adds her Essence rating in extra successes to Performance rolls made for herself and her allies for the rest of the scene.

label: Chosen of Battles
description: Heaven's Soldiers, the Chosen of Battles serve the Maiden of Battles and the Crimson Panoply of Victory. They are ever on guard and ready to enforce the will of the Celestial Hierarchy.
anima_powers: By spending 10 motes, the character reduces by one health level the damage of all attacks made against herself and her allies for the rest of the scene.

label: Chosen of Secrets
description: Heaven's Eyes, the Chosen of Secrets serve the Maiden of Secrets and the Forbidding Manse of Ivy. They uncover all the things that Heaven must know, working in hidden actions and unspoken truths.
anima_powers: By spending 10 motes, the character protects herself and her allies against all forms of mind control and thought reading for the rest of the scene.

label: Chosen of Endings
description: Heaven's Gardeners, the Chosen of Endings serve the Maiden of Endings and the Violet Bier of Sorrows. They oversee and instigate the Celestially mandated ending of all things.
anima_powers: By spending 10 motes, the character adds one health level of damage to all attacks made by herself and her allies for the rest of the scene.

label: Orichalcum
description: The Shining Ones (Archons): brilliant, personable leaders and sages, the brightest examples of the Great Maker's inspiration and the Tripartite's foremost experts on dogma and abstract policy.
anima_powers: For a reflexive cost of 5 motes, an Orichalcum Caste may charge their body with golden lightning for a scene. Whenever they strike in close combat this energy surges at the point of contact, and all projectiles crackle with a destructive nimbus as they leave the Exalt's hand or weapon. This power adds the character's Essence to the damage of all attacks.

label: Moonsilver
description: The Mirrorblades (Proteans): the hidden spies, assassins, scouts and secret police of Autochthonian society, renowned for the quickness and flexibility of their minds and bodies alike.
anima_powers: For a reflexive cost of 5 motes, a Moonsilver Caste may suffuse her being with the flowing grace of quicksilver for a scene, her quickened senses perceiving the world in slow motion. This power adds (the character's Essence rating x 2) to her base initiative for the scene.

label: Jade
description: The Stone Hands (Executives): the approachable middle management and frontline officers of the Great Maker, and the public face of the Alchemical Exalted as a whole.
anima_powers: By reflexively spending 5 motes, a Jade Caste can fortify their flesh against injury for a scene, transmuting their claylike flesh into a sheath of flexible stone. This power adds the character's Essence to their natural bashing and lethal soak for the scene.

label: Starmetal
description: The Plot Weavers (Viziers): social engineers, motivational theorists, psychological operatives and subtle backroom plotters who manage the Autochthonian intelligence services and counsel the Tripartite from the shadows.
anima_powers: For a reflexive cost of 5 motes, a Starmetal Caste can align their soul and Essence with the Design of the Great Maker for a scene, a prismatic halo trailing slightly ahead of them. This power adds (the Exalt's Essence / 2, rounded up) to all attack, damage and base initiative rolls for the scene.

label: Soulsteel
description: The Grim Watch (Sentinels): the fearsome, all-seeing enforcers of law and dogma, tasked with hunting down and eliminating Autochthonian dissidents and gremlins.
anima_powers: By reflexively spending 5 motes, a Soulsteel Caste may stir the souls trapped in their frame, generating an aura of numbing dread for a scene. This power adds (the Exalt's Essence / 2, rounded up) to the difficulty of all attacks targeting the Alchemical. Even automatons and the walking dead suffer this penalty; only living beings with perfect immunity to fear may ignore it.

label: Ghost-Blooded
description: The living children of the Restless Dead. Half-Dead grow up in the shadowlands, surrounded from birth by the cycles of life and death, and learn the Arcanoi of their ghostly parents exactly as the dead do. (PG p.55)
anima_powers: God-Blooded do not display an anima banner; the single exception is a character with the Aura of Power Flaw (p.67), who must contend with an aura like the Exalted. Ghost-Blooded become increasingly ghostly and translucent, lit from within by a cold spectral fire that spills from their eyes and mouth.

heritage_traits.heritage_power: Half-Dead may attune their senses to the Essence of the Underworld as a basic dice action for a cost of 1 Willpower point or 3 motes of Essence, perceiving all shadowland borders and immaterial ghosts within the range of her normal senses for one scene. (PG p.55)

label: Half-Caste
description: The descendants of the Chosen, born of an Exalt's union with a mortal. Half-Caste learn the Charms of their parent's Exalted type but may not master any Charms that provide a perfect defense or persistent scene-length defense, and they receive no Charms at character creation. (PG p.47)
anima_powers: God-Blooded do not display an anima banner; the single exception is a character with the Aura of Power Flaw (p.67). Half-Caste with the Anima Powers Merit receive the basic anima powers of their parent's Exalted type: Golden Children may spend motes to determine the time of day or illuminate their pale Caste Marks, Shadewalkers may grow fangs to consume blood for Essence, and Lunar Half-Caste illuminate only their Caste Mark (they have no Tell).

heritage_traits.heritage_power: Half-Caste receive additional dots of Attributes during character creation (6/5/4, per the prose on p.47) but otherwise exhibit no mystical birthright of their heritage. (PG p.60)

label: Fae-Blooded
description: The children of the Fair Folk do not use Charms, but instead, wield gifts of glamour to beguile and enchant and bend reality according to their half-Wyld nature. These powers take the form of proprietary Merits. (PG p.47)
anima_powers: God-Blooded do not display an anima banner; the single exception is a character with the Aura of Power Flaw (p.67). Fae-Blooded regaining Essence only while resting in the Wyld or within an uncapped Demesne rated at 3+ (p.66).

heritage_traits.heritage_power: Like their inchoate parents, Fae-Blooded have nothing to fear from the maddening and warping power of the Wyld. Changelings may journey into the deepest chaos and retain their form and sanity, though the same protection does not extend to their possessions. This constant aegis duplicates the effects of the Solar Charm Integrity-Protecting Prana (Exalted p.186), save that it does not protect against glamour and other willfully directed uses of Wyld energies. (PG p.60)
